individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A shows spatial heatmap plots of deconvolution scores overlaid on tissue images; heatmaps are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel B is a box plot, which already displays the distribution of the underlying data (and individual points are additionally overlaid), so it is exempt from this check.
Panel C consists of GSEA enrichment line plots; line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.
Panel D is a bar chart showing log2 fold-change values per gene from a DEG analysis; no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Panel E consists of representative micrographs (H&E and IHC images), not a plot of averaged data, so this check does not apply.

error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: not needed - Panel A is a spatial heatmap without error bars or box-plot elements.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: The box plots represent the distribution of values for each group, extending from the 25th percentile to the 75th percentile; ... (minima=..., median=..., maxima=..., Q1=..., Q3=...)
error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: PASS - the caption explicitly defines the box plot elements (25th-75th percentile box, plus minima, median, maxima, Q1 and Q3 values for each group).
not needed - Panel C shows GSEA enrichment line plots without error bars.
not needed - Panel D bars display log2 fold-change values with p-values annotated, but no error bars are drawn on the bars.
